reasons: Cited Section 24 text supports the compliant classification: 24.1 grants Customer an affiliate/successor assignment right without Vendor consent (notice only), 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment/delegation/change-of-control transfer subject to Customer consent with a reasonableness qualifier and a competitor bar, 24.3 sets a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard, and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration, or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding, and the deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out passes.

The competitor bar in 24.2 is framed as 'never ... without Customer's consent' rather than absolute, but the gate is Customer's own unqualified consent, so the protection is functionally equivalent to the preferred position and does not warrant a deviation finding.
